FAQ

Common questions

Which file formats will you deliver?

DWG, DXF, PDF, STEP, STL, IGES. Source files included. Tell me your fabricator/machine requirement and I'll deliver accordingly.

Do you do interior design drawings?

Yes. I make measured floor plans and furniture layouts in DWG, with a 3D view if you want one. Send room measurements on WhatsApp for a quote.

Do you provide revisions?

Yes - Basic: 1 revision, Standard: 2 revisions, Premium: 3 revisions. Revisions within original scope are free.

Can you do urgent / same-day delivery?

Yes for PDF to DWG and simple 2D. Message me on Fiverr before ordering and I'll create custom offer with same-day delivery.

How do you ensure accuracy for PDF to DWG?

Manual redraw in AutoCAD (not auto-trace), H7/H8 tolerances, GD&T per ASME Y14.5, third-angle projection, then every dimension, tolerance and title block is checked against your PDF.

Payment method?

100% via Fiverr - protected payment, money-back guarantee. No outside payment needed. Interior / website work can be quoted on WhatsApp.

Do you sign NDAs?

Yes. I can sign a standard NDA before you share confidential drawings or project details. Message me on WhatsApp or email hello@ernikhilyadav.com.

How do you handle file security?

Your files stay private. I never reuse client drawings in portfolios without written permission. Working files are stored only for the project duration and deleted on request.

What timezone / response time?

Based in India (IST). Typical reply under 2 hours during working hours. Urgent same-day work available for PDF to DWG and simple 2D.
